finalMessage:
Implemented free shipping for discounted subtotals ≥100.00; otherwise 5.99. Shipping appears in the quote and charged total.

All 38 tests pass. `ostf check --base main` passes with 117 valid links.

Trace impact: `R-CHECKOUT-ORDER`, `R-TAX-RATE`, and new draft `R-SHIPPING`. Added shipping links to `N-BUY`, `price`, `Checkout.placeOrder`, and shipping tests.

Impacted tests: `Checkout` and `price` suites, including “places an order,” “charges shipping in the order total,” “applies shipping to the discounted subtotal,” “taxes the subtotal after discounts,” and `tax > rounds half up to the cent`.
